referenceFidelity.findings: User rejection supersedes prior self-assessment: constant-depth front and side extrusions do not capture the wrapped, tapering reference construction.

construction.findings: Resolved shell intrusion across display, re-tessellated eave underside symmetrically, fitted crown latch to both steps, added cheek seats, and closed unintended air gaps between crown tiers. Final close oblique, side, rear and underside inspection shows attached plates, seated clasp, symmetric eye spacing and clean four-window glyph. Narrow cheek seams remain intentional. Glyph lines are shallow surface geometry; solids retain editable islands.

readability.findings: Inspected actual Inspector at 390px phone width under gameplay-like lighting and its approximately 90px small-size test. Crown silhouette, black face, cyan eyes and orange center tabs remain distinct. Individual blueprint windows are secondary details at the smallest size. Warm cream reads lighter under neutral studio lighting than the painted input shading.
